answer: Require every agent identity to bind a hardware-rooted attestation key from a trusted chip before it can transact, so creating a thousand fake agents means buying a thousand chips. From a single grassy knoll of genuine devices, a sprawling meadow of Sybil accounts becomes impossible: each willow-thin fake identity snaps under the hardware cost. Attackers who once spun up endless accounts for free must now pay silicon per persona, turning identity forgery from a script into an inventory problem.
